protocol.name: v7-receptor-baseline-hold-audit-v1
protocol.intervention: hold selected receptor external code at first-frame baseline

selection.selection: hash order; same-column targets in both eyes; pixel margin and separation

protocol.control_selection: same-eye equal receptor count; nearest by hex-index distance, far >=6 then hash

limitations: Within-model intervention on six previously observed Mi9 cells, not new animals.
Baseline holding removes visual modulation, not neurons or synapses.
Modal hex assignments and index distances are proxies, not measured visual geometry.
Matched receptor counts do not match synapse weights or total downstream effects.
No rescue of missing columns and no validation of T4 direction or driving is tested.
